card.name: Punctuation and words ending warning-label phrases
card.fires_on: Marks the end of a risk phrase in warning text: a comma or period after 'without warning' or 'at any time', and 'Behavior' in 'Suicidal Behavior'. It also fires on the closing part of serious-event terms such as 'Infections' or a closing parenthesis.
